 England XI vs Croatia: Starting lineup and confirmed team news as Kane handed 126th cap
 Harry Kane set for a historic and record-breaking night at Wembley 
 Allow Exco Player content
 This content is provided by Exco Player and may use cookies or similar technologies. Please click 'Allow and Continue' below to load the content.
 Allow and Continue Dom Smith , Football Reporter @ MrDomSmith 2 minutes ago 
 COMMENTS England take on Croatia again in the Nations League tonight, on what will be a memorable evening for Harry Kane at Wembley.
 The Three Lions captain will move clear of Peter Shilton as his country’s most-capped men’s player of all time on his 126th senior appearance, while also showcasing his newly-won Ballon d’Or award.
 CLICK HERE TO FOLLOW ENGLAND VS CROATIA LIVE! 
 Kane leads Thomas Tuchel’s attack as usual against a team that were thrashed 7-0 by England in Rijeka last month , supported by Anthony Gordon, Jude Bellingham and Morgan Rogers.
 Dan Burn gets the nod following his call-up as a replacement for the injured Marc Guehi. He partners Jarell Quansah at the back, with Trent Alexander-Arnold on the right and Lewis Hall on the left.
 Arsenal defender Ezri Konsa will not be available for the Croatia game, but is expected to return to full training ahead of Sunday’s trip to Spain.
 He has been following his own individualised programme while the rest of the squad train at Tottenham’s Hotspur Way.
 Jobe Bellingham, younger brother of Jude, is in the senior England squad for the first time. He, Josh King and veteran Brighton goalkeeper Jason Steele are the only uncapped players called up by Tuchel.
 Confirmed team news 
 England XI vs Croatia (4-2-3-1): Pickford, Alexander-Arnold, Quansah, Burn, Hall, Anderson, Rice, Rogers, Bellingham, Gordon, Kane
 Subs: Trafford, Steele, Gibbs-White, White, Hill, Branthwaite, Jobe Bellingham, Garner, Calvert-Lewin, Ngumoha, King, Eze
 Injured: Guehi, Konsa, Spence
 Time and date: 7:45pm GMT on Thursday November 12, 2026
 Venue: Wembley Stadium
 How to watch: ITV
